Class FileCredentialRotation<M extends TransferModule>

java.lang.Object
ecmwf.common.ectrans.FileCredentialRotation<M>
All Implemented Interfaces:
CredentialProbe<PasswordRotation.Endpoint, String>, PasswordRotation
public abstract class FileCredentialRotation<M extends TransferModule> extends Object implements PasswordRotation
Common bounded write/cleanup probe for modules with an isolated, encrypted credential connection.
